dataset: google/fleurs test split (CC BY 4.0), first N rows of test.tsv

normalisation.all: lowercase; every Unicode punctuation character replaced by a space; spaces collapsed
normalisation.ar: also: diacritics (U+064B-U+0652, U+0670) and tatweel removed; أ إ آ -> ا; ى -> ي; ة -> ه
normalisation.not_done: no number normalisation (e.g. '100' vs 'one hundred' counts as an error)
normalisation.en_extra: wer_whisper_normaliser: English WER with Whisper's EnglishTextNormalizer (numbers to digits, contractions; no spelling map), the usual way Whisper FLEURS numbers are reported
